data.name: Husk
data.description: HUSK is a biochar producer headquartered in Singapore with operations in Cambodia (since 2019) and Vietnam (since 2024) that transforms rice husks into biochar-based fertilizers using pyrolysis. The company issues EBC/Global Biochar C-Sink carbon removal credits and has signed a seven-year, 20,000-tonne offtake with atmosfair (funding a new plant commissioning in Kampong Thom in November 2025) alongside a July 2024 investment from Mekong Capital.
